batch.selection: Microsoft 405 份待审母集按冻结顺序排列的第 4 批 60 份资料
batch.admissionRule: 总分至少 6/10，且知识重要性至少 2/3

results.title: Assess AI systems by using the Responsible AI dashboard
results.description: Learn how to use the comprehensive UI and SDK/YAML components in the Responsible AI dashboard to debug your machine learning models and make data-driven decisions.

scores.rationale: 负责任 AI 仪表板把误差分析、公平性、因果与反事实工具组织为系统诊断流程。

results.title: Share Responsible AI insights using the Responsible AI scorecard (preview)
results.description: Learn about how to use the Responsible AI scorecard to share responsible AI insights from your machine learning models and make data-driven decisions with nontechnical and technical stakeholders.

scores.rationale: 责任 AI 记分卡把模型风险与指标转化为跨技术和业务角色可沟通的证据。

results.title: Frequently asked questions about forecasting in AutoML
results.description: Read answers to frequently asked questions about forecasting in AutoML.

scores.rationale: FAQ 主要汇总零散操作问题，预测核心机制已由专题资料覆盖。

results.title: How to deploy an AutoML model to an online endpoint
results.description: Learn to use the Azure Machine Learning studio, SDK, and CLI to deploy your AutoML model as a web service that Azure automatically manages.

scores.rationale: 部署 AutoML 在线端点属于 Azure 平台操作，缺少独立通用知识。

results.title: Make predictions with ONNX on computer vision models from AutoML
results.description: Use ONNX with Azure Machine Learning automated ML to make predictions on computer vision models for classification, object detection, and instance segmentation.

scores.rationale: ONNX 推理说明模型导出与跨运行时执行边界，具有部署和互操作价值。

results.title: Model interpretability
results.description: Learn how your machine learning model makes predictions during training and inferencing by using the Azure Machine Learning CLI and Python SDK.

scores.rationale: 模型可解释性涵盖特征归因与训练、推理阶段解释，是负责任机器学习核心。

results.title: Prepare data for computer vision tasks by using automated machine learning
results.description: Learn about image data preparation for Azure Machine Learning to train computer vision models on classification, object detection, and segmentation.

scores.rationale: 视觉任务的数据格式与标注准备有通用实践价值，但内容部分绑定 AutoML。

results.title: Use the Responsible AI dashboard in Azure Machine Learning studio
results.description: Learn how to use the various tools and visualization charts in the Responsible AI dashboard in Azure Machine Learning.

scores.rationale: 页面主要讲解 Responsible AI 仪表板的界面操作，机制已由概念页覆盖。

results.title: Generate Responsible AI insights in the studio UI
results.description: Learn how to generate Responsible AI insights with no-code experience in the Azure Machine Learning studio UI.

scores.rationale: 无代码生成洞察属于 Azure ML Studio 操作流程，不形成独立技术结论。

results.title: Use Responsible AI scorecard (preview) in Azure Machine Learning
results.description: Share insights with nontechnical business stakeholders by exporting a PDF Responsible AI scorecard from Azure Machine Learning.

scores.rationale: 导出 PDF 记分卡是产品操作步骤，知识增量已由记分卡概念页覆盖。

results.title: Set up MLOps with Azure DevOps
results.description: Learn how to set up a sample MLOps environment in Azure Machine Learning

scores.rationale: Azure DevOps MLOps 页面以样例环境和平台配置为主，通用方法增量不足。

results.title: Set up MLOps with GitHub
results.description: Learn how to set up a sample MLOps environment in Azure Machine Learning with GitHub Actions

scores.rationale: GitHub Actions MLOps 页面主要是 Azure ML 集成步骤，与通用 LLMOps 资料重复。

results.title: Hyperparameter tuning a model (v2)
results.description: Discover how to define search spaces, choose sampling algorithms, and configure early termination policies for hyperparameter tuning in Azure ML.

scores.rationale: 搜索空间、采样算法与提前终止共同构成超参数优化的核心方法。

results.title: Train a small object detection model with AutoML
results.description: Set up Azure Machine Learning automated ML to train small object detection models with the CLI v2 and Python SDK v2.

scores.rationale: 小目标检测页面是 AutoML 特定训练流程，适用面过窄。

results.title: Upgrade AutoML to SDK v2
results.description: Upgrade AutoML from v1 to v2 of Azure Machine Learning SDK

scores.rationale: SDK v1 到 v2 的迁移步骤时效短且不教授可复用 AI 机制。

results.title: Monitoring evaluation metrics descriptions and use cases
results.description: Understand the metrics used when monitoring the performance of generative AI models deployed to production on Azure Machine Learning.

scores.rationale: 生成式 AI 生产监控指标连接质量、安全、延迟和漂移，是持续评估基础。

results.title: Hyperparameters for computer vision tasks in automated machine learning
results.description: Learn which hyperparameters are available for computer vision tasks with automated ML.

scores.rationale: 视觉 AutoML 超参数参考对选型有用，但参数表随产品演进且适用范围集中。

results.title: Data schemas to train computer vision models with automated machine learning
results.description: Learn how to format your JSONL files for data consumption in automated ML experiments for computer vision tasks with the CLI v2 and Python SDK v2.

scores.rationale: JSONL 数据模式页面属于 AutoML 接口格式说明，不具独立知识价值。

results.title: Durable state store for Microsoft Foundry hosted agents (preview)
results.description: Learn how the Microsoft Foundry durable state store preserves hosted agent data with user isolation, tags, expiration, and service limits.

scores.rationale: 持久状态存储明确用户隔离、过期和服务限制，是托管智能体状态治理的官方边界。

results.title: Resilience for long-running Microsoft Foundry hosted agents (preview)
results.description: Understand how Microsoft Foundry hosted agents preserve long-running work, recover after process interruptions, and replay streamed results.

scores.rationale: 长任务中断恢复与流式结果重放直接决定智能体韧性，机制独特且重要。

results.title: Routines in Foundry Agent Service
results.description: Learn how routines in Foundry Agent Service invoke agents from timers, schedules, GitHub issues, and Microsoft Teams messages.

scores.rationale: 定时器和事件触发的例程具有自动化价值，但主要绑定 Foundry Agent Service。

results.title: Build with agents, conversations, and responses
results.description: Learn how agents, conversations, and responses work together in Foundry Agent Service, and choose the runtime components your application needs.

scores.rationale: 智能体、会话与响应组件的职责边界是理解托管代理运行时的核心架构。

results.title: Tool best practices for Microsoft Foundry Agent Service
results.description: Learn tool best practices for Foundry Agent Service: configure tool_choice, secure tool usage, and troubleshoot tool-calling issues.

scores.rationale: 工具选择、安全调用与故障诊断原则适用于多数生产智能体。

results.title: What is Toolbox in Foundry?
results.description: Learn how a toolbox packages agent tools behind a single managed MCP endpoint in Microsoft Foundry, with centralized authentication, tool search, and skills.

scores.rationale: Toolbox 以统一 MCP 端点封装工具、认证与搜索，是官方独有的工具治理模式。

results.title: Vector stores for file search
results.description: Learn how vector stores enable file search for agents, including ingestion (chunking and embeddings), readiness, limits, and expiration policies.

scores.rationale: 文件搜索向量存储的切块、嵌入、就绪与过期策略构成完整检索生命周期。

results.title: Voice agent tracing, monitoring, and evaluation
results.description: Learn what is different when you trace, monitor, and evaluate voice-based agents in Microsoft Foundry.

scores.rationale: 语音智能体在追踪、延迟和轮次评估上的特殊要求具有独立多模态价值。

results.title: Memory in Microsoft Foundry Agent Service (preview)
results.description: Learn about memory in Foundry Agent Service, including how it works, long-term memory types, retention and item-level controls, and security considerations.

scores.rationale: 长期记忆的类型、保留和项目级控制是智能体个性化与安全的关键边界。

results.title: Build a workflow in Microsoft Foundry (Preview)
results.description: Build workflows in Microsoft Foundry to orchestrate AI agents with visual logic, branching, and Power Fx formulas. Create intelligent automation without writing code.

scores.rationale: 可视化 Foundry 工作流页面偏无代码界面和 Power Fx 操作，通用编排资料已覆盖。

results.title: AI Red Teaming Agent
results.description: This article provides conceptual overview of the AI Red Teaming Agent.

scores.rationale: AI 红队智能体系统化生成攻击并评估风险，是安全验证的重要独立方法。

results.title: Agent evaluators
results.description: Learn how to evaluate Azure AI agents using intent resolution, tool call accuracy, and task adherence evaluators.

scores.rationale: 意图解析、工具调用准确率和任务遵循等代理指标补足传统模型评测。

results.title: Azure OpenAI graders
results.description: Learn about Azure OpenAI Graders for evaluating AI model outputs, including label grading, string checking, text similarity, and custom grading.

scores.rationale: Azure OpenAI graders 提供多种评分器边界，达到保留线但产品依赖较强。

results.title: Custom evaluators (preview)
results.description: Learn how to create custom evaluators for your AI applications using code-based, prompt-based, or endpoint-based approaches.

scores.rationale: 代码、提示和端点式自定义评估器支持领域化质量定义，适用面广。

results.title: General purpose evaluators
results.description: Learn about general-purpose evaluators for generative AI, including coherence and fluency evaluators.

scores.rationale: 流畅性与连贯性等通用评估器是生成质量基线，但容易被其他评测资料替代。

results.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) evaluators
results.description: Learn about Retrieval-Augmented Generation evaluators for assessing relevance, groundedness, and response completeness in generative AI systems.

scores.rationale: RAG 评估器分离相关性、忠实度与完整性，是检索增强系统的核心质量框架。

results.title: Risk and safety evaluators
results.description: Learn about risk and safety evaluators for generative AI, including tools for assessing content safety, jailbreak vulnerabilities, and code security risks.

scores.rationale: 风险与安全评估器覆盖内容危害、越狱和代码风险，是上线门禁的重要组成。

results.title: Rubric evaluators (preview)
results.description: Learn about rubric evaluators for AI agents, which let you define custom scoring criteria with descriptive rubrics for LLM-as-judge evaluation.

scores.rationale: 描述性评分规程把 LLM 裁判标准显式化，有助于一致性和可审计性。

results.title: Textual similarity evaluators
results.description: Learn about textual similarity evaluators for generative AI, including semantic similarity, F1 score, BLEU, GLEU, ROUGE, and METEOR metrics.

scores.rationale: 语义相似度、F1、BLEU 与 ROUGE 等指标提供文本评测工具箱，但并非品牌独有。

results.title: Observability in generative AI
results.description: Learn how Microsoft Foundry enables safe, high-quality generative AI through systematic evaluation and observability tools.

scores.rationale: 生成式 AI 观测把离线评测与线上追踪连接成持续质量闭环。

results.title: Microsoft Foundry rollout across my organization
results.description: Learn how to plan the rollout of Microsoft Foundry across your organization, including environment setup, data isolation, and governance.

scores.rationale: 组织范围的 Foundry 推广页面主要讨论环境部署和平台治理流程。

results.title: Retrieval augmented generation (RAG) and indexes
results.description: Learn how retrieval augmented generation (RAG) uses indexes and grounding data to improve response accuracy in generative AI apps.

scores.rationale: RAG 与索引总览建立数据接入、检索和基础化的完整路径，但基础原理已有主资料。

results.title: Guardrails and controls overview in Microsoft Foundry
results.description: Learn about safety and security guardrails that can be applied to models and agents in Microsoft Foundry, including risks, intervention points, and response actions.

scores.rationale: 护栏总览系统列出风险、干预点与响应动作，是模型和智能体安全控制基础。

results.title: Configure guided guardrail set-up for an agent (preview)
results.description: Learn how to configure guardrails for your agent in Microsoft Foundry by answering guided questions about its users, data, and tools.

scores.rationale: 引导式护栏设置主要是问答配置流程，核心机制由护栏总览和干预点覆盖。

results.title: How to configure guardrails and controls in Microsoft Foundry
results.description: Create, configure, and manage guardrails and controls for model deployments and agents in Microsoft Foundry using the portal or REST API.

scores.rationale: 护栏配置页给出部署与智能体控制的落地契约，达到最低保留线。

results.title: Intervention points
results.description: Learn about Agentic AI intervention points.

scores.rationale: 干预点明确输入、推理、工具与输出各阶段可实施的控制，是护栏架构核心。

results.title: Agentic Workflows: Task Adherence (preview)
results.description: Learn how to use Task Adherence to ensure AI agents align with user instructions and task objectives.

scores.rationale: 任务遵循直接检测代理是否偏离用户目标，是智能体特有且重要的安全评测。

results.title: Agent tracing overview
results.description: Learn how agent tracing in Microsoft Foundry captures inputs, outputs, and tool usage with OpenTelemetry. Debug agent runs, identify latency issues, and improve reliability.

scores.rationale: 基于 OpenTelemetry 的代理追踪覆盖输入、输出和工具调用，是故障诊断基础。

results.title: Tracing and data handling
results.description: Tracing in Microsoft Foundry captures execution data to improve AI agent performance. Find out how to enable, disable, and govern trace data.

scores.rationale: 追踪数据处理明确采集、停用和治理边界，对隐私与可观测性同样关键。

results.title: Use Insights in Foundry (preview)
results.description: Learn how to run Insights scans, review recurring production behaviors and supporting traces, and route confirmed Insights to evaluation or optimization workflows.

scores.rationale: 生产行为聚类并回连证据轨迹能发现重复失败模式，提供独特持续改进机制。

results.title: Run benchmark evaluations in Microsoft Foundry (preview)
results.description: Learn how to use benchmark evaluations in Microsoft Foundry to evaluate model and agent quality against built-in benchmark datasets and metrics.

scores.rationale: 基准评测支持跨模型和代理质量比较，但内置数据集与指标可能快速变化。

results.title: Introduction to cloud evaluation with Microsoft Foundry SDK
results.description: Set up the Microsoft Foundry SDK and choose a cloud evaluation workflow for datasets, targets, interactions, conversations, or synthetic data.

scores.rationale: 云评测入口说明数据集、目标和交互等工作流选择，达到保留线但偏 SDK。

results.title: Evaluate conversation datasets with Microsoft Foundry SDK (preview)
results.description: Learn how to use the Microsoft Foundry SDK to evaluate complete conversation datasets at the turn or conversation level.

scores.rationale: 会话级评测保留跨轮状态和目标完成度，是单轮指标不能替代的质量层次。

results.title: Evaluate existing datasets with Microsoft Foundry SDK
results.description: Learn how to use the Microsoft Foundry SDK to evaluate JSONL and CSV datasets with uploaded or inline data, schemas, and evaluator mappings.

scores.rationale: 现有数据集评测包含模式与评估器映射的实用契约，但平台相关性较强。

results.title: Evaluate deployed model and agent conversations with Microsoft Foundry SDK (preview)
results.description: Learn how to use the Microsoft Foundry SDK to evaluate traced production conversations by conversation ID or agent filter.

scores.rationale: 从生产轨迹抽取完整会话进行评测连接了线上行为与离线质量闭环。

results.title: Evaluate individual interactions from deployed models and agents with Microsoft Foundry SDK
results.description: Learn how to use the Microsoft Foundry SDK to evaluate deployed agent and model interactions by response ID or Application Insights trace.

scores.rationale: 按响应或轨迹评测单次交互有实用性，但与通用云评测流程高度相似。

results.title: Get evaluation results with Microsoft Foundry SDK
results.description: Learn how to poll cloud evaluation runs, interpret results, review model-target latency and estimated cost, cancel runs, and troubleshoot errors.

scores.rationale: 结果轮询、成本和延迟解释是评测运行必要环节，但独立机制增量有限。

results.title: Simulate conversations with the Microsoft Foundry SDK (preview)
results.description: Use the Microsoft Foundry SDK to generate simulated conversations from scenarios and evaluate agent behavior.

scores.rationale: 模拟多轮对话可在上线前覆盖状态性失败和复杂用户路径。

results.title: Generate synthetic evaluation data with Microsoft Foundry SDK (preview)
results.description: Learn how to use the Microsoft Foundry SDK to generate synthetic evaluation queries for model and agent targets.

scores.rationale: 合成评测查询扩展边界场景覆盖，是低真实数据条件下的重要方法。

results.title: Evaluate model and agent targets with Microsoft Foundry SDK
results.description: Learn how to use the Microsoft Foundry SDK to evaluate model, prompt-agent, and hosted-agent targets with responses and invocations protocols.

scores.rationale: 统一目标评测契约有实践价值，但大部分内容是 Foundry SDK 接口。

results.title: Analyze evaluation results with cluster analysis (preview)
results.description: Learn how to run and interact with an evaluation cluster analysis.

scores.rationale: 评测结果聚类把大量失败自动归纳为问题簇，具有独特诊断价值。

results.title: Use admin-connected models in cloud evaluations
results.description: Learn how to use models connected through an enterprise AI gateway as evaluators, targets, and simulators in Microsoft Foundry cloud evaluations.

scores.rationale: 管理员连接模型页面绑定企业 AI 网关和 Foundry 配置，通用知识增量不足。
